samplingPolicy.events: 1 day across conservative ±45-day official event campaigns
samplingPolicy.closeEncounters: 6 hours across nested conservative ±4-day close windows
samplingPolicy.eventWindowNote: Official date-only events use conservative windows; exact future Europa flyby times are not asserted.

queryPolicy.backoff: Retry-After when supplied; otherwise exponential 1, 2, 4, 8 seconds

assetPolicy.hash: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 asset bytes
assetPolicy.cleanup: Only stale JSON carrying this generator ownership marker and schema is removed.

actualPredictionBoundary.classificationRule: Samples with jdTdb < predictionStartsJdTdb are actual/reconstructed; samples at or after it are predicted.
actualPredictionBoundary.basis: Offline-snapshot operational boundary. Samples through this date are classified as actual/reconstructed; later samples are classified as predicted. Horizons does not provide a per-vector status flag.
